annotation.title_clean: Uchwała nr 196 Rady Ministrów z dnia 28 grudnia 2020 r. w sprawie ustanowienia „Polityki dla rozwoju sztucznej inteligencji w Polsce od roku 2020”
annotation.title_en: Resolution No. 196 of the Council of Ministers of 28 December 2020 establishing the "Policy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence in Poland from 2020"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Rada Ministrów Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej (Council of Ministers of Poland)
annotation.venue: Monitor Polski (Dziennik Urzędowy RP), poz. 23, 12 January 2021
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Polish Council of Ministers resolution adopting the national AI Policy: short-, medium- and long-term goals across six areas (society, firms, science, education, international cooperation, public sector). Mostly innovation and talent policy aligned with EU trustworthy-AI. Few embodied provisions: testing zones for autonomous vehicles and vessels, drone law, opposition to AI legal personhood.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the Polish AI Policy; the minister for digitalisation executes it and reports annually to the Council of Ministers by 1 September.
Sets goals to 2023, 2027 and beyond across six areas, including reskilling, funding and public procurement of AI.
Calls for designated zones to test autonomous ground, water and air vehicles to clarify liability of algorithm creators and operators.
Plans legal updates for autonomous drones used in agriculture and infrastructure inspection.
Ethical-legal framework opposes granting AI legal personality; developers liable on a due-care basis and operators on a risk basis.
